expectedChanges: Create one disposable canary file under .change-canary.
Exercise post-merge trusted workflows with Plan text containing newline and bidi formatting control characters.
Verify run-attempt-specific trusted evidence artifact names across a rerun.
hqDecisions: This PR is a disposable closure canary and must be closed unmerged.
Machine Plan values remain literal; human logs must render control and bidi characters as visible escapes.
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Disposable trust-boundary canary; validation is by trusted workflows, logs, artifact inspection, and rerun provenance.
plan.rollback: Close this canary PR unmerged; no staging/main or production content change is intended.
outOfScope: Phase E semantic scope and concurrency controls
unverified: This canary validates trusted mechanical evidence only and does not declare final VERIFIED.
plan.problem: The final C3-1 closure audit requires live proof that Plan-controlled human text is safely escaped, trusted external Actions execute from pinned commits, and rerun evidence artifacts are unambiguous by attempt.
plan.currentContract: staging/main now escapes candidate Plan text at Scope and Impact human-rendering boundaries, pins trusted external Actions to full commit SHAs, and names evidence artifacts with run ID plus run attempt.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Source tests and pre-merge checks do not prove the newly merged base-owned workflow source executes correctly or that rerun artifact names separate attempts in live Actions.
plan.design: Open a disposable lock-first PR with one canary file and Plan text containing newline plus U+202E. Inspect trusted human logs and attempt-1 evidence, rerun the verification job, verify a distinct attempt-2 artifact name and provenance, then close unmerged.
alternativesRejected: Reuse an older canary branch; it predates the final trust-hardening merge.
Merge the canary; unnecessary residue would remain in staging/main.
Rely only on unit tests; they cannot prove post-merge base-owned Actions and rerun artifact identity.
plan.compatibility: Disposable staging-only canary; no canonical product behavior changes.
boundaryCases: Plan change text containing newline renders as literal backslash-n in Scope and Impact logs.
U+202E renders as literal backslash-u202e rather than reordering visible text.
Attempt 1 and attempt 2 produce different artifact names containing the same run ID and their respective attempts.
testPlan: Open the disposable PR and wait for Change Operations Tests, Change PR Gate, and Change Verification Evidence.
Inspect Scope and Impact human logs for escaped newline and bidi control text.
Inspect attempt-1 evidence and artifact name.
Rerun the trusted verification job and inspect attempt-2 evidence and distinct artifact name.
Close unmerged and confirm staging/main plus production/main are unchanged.
plan.promotionRisk: Disposable staging canary only; no merge or production promotion is intended.
